title: Mem2Fair: Online Fairness Control for Text-to-Video Generation via Fair Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.19215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce systematically unfair demographic outcomes when prompts leave protected attributes unspecified. For example, prompts describing nurses without specifying gender may disproportionately generate videos depicting female nurses. Mitigating unfairness in T2V generation is particularly challenging: training-based methods that modify model internals require architecture-specific access and risk disrupting temporal consistency, while sampling-based methods often incur costly pre-deployment video generation. We present the first conditional online approachability formulation of attribute-level fairness for T2V generation. Building on this formulation, we introduce Mem2Fair, a plug-and-play framework that maintains concept-conditioned Fair Memory. translated_title: Mem2Fair：基于公平记忆的文本到视频生成在线公平性控制
translated_abstract: 当提示词未明确指定受保护属性时，文本到视频（T2V）生成模型可能产生系统性不公平的人口统计结果。例如，描述护士但未指定性别的提示词可能会不成比例地生成描绘女性护士的视频。缓解T2V生成中的不公平性尤其具有挑战性：基于训练的方法需要修改模型内部，要求架构特定的访问权限，并有破坏时间一致性的风险；而基于采样的方法通常需要在部署前进行代价高昂的视频生成。我们提出了首个针对T2V生成属性级公平性的条件化在线可达性（online approachability）形式化方法。基于这一形式化方法，我们提出了Mem2Fair，这是一个即插即用的框架，它维护着以概念为条件的公平记忆（Fair Memory）。该框架利用推理时生成的视频作为反馈，根据每个概念相对于……的偏差来选择提示级别的属性干预（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: Mem2Fair是一个即插即用的在线公平性控制框架，通过维护概念条件化的公平记忆，以推理时生成的视频作为反馈来选择提示级别的属性干预，从而缓解文本到视频生成中提示词未指定属性时的系统性人口统计偏差。
en_tdlr: Mem2Fair is a plug-and-play online fairness control framework that maintains a concept-conditioned Fair Memory and uses generated videos at inference time as feedback to select prompt-level attribute interventions, mitigating systematic demographic bias in text-to-video generation when prompts leave protected attributes unspecified.
